Linh stopped, her heart heavy. Because of this, she realized her busy schedule and English studies were making Mai feel alone. Linh decided to change. They still played English games daily, now with new words and more laughter. Linh had found her "language link," not just for work, but for a stronger, happier family.
endWrap: Linh discovered that learning could be a bridge, connecting her career goals with her family's happiness. Her language link brought joy to everyone.

One afternoon, Mai came home from school excited. "Mommy, I learned a new word! 'Apple'!" she said, holding up a drawing. Linh was on a video call for work. She quickly smiled, "That's great, sweetie! Later." Linh then turned back to her screen, missing Mai's eager face fall. Later that afternoon, Linh was still busy with her remote work. Mai, feeling ignored, went to her room. Linh heard soft voices. Mai was talking to her teddy bear. "Mommy is always busy," Mai whispered sadly. "I wish she had more time for me." Hearing this, Linh's heart ached. She realized her busy schedule was making Mai feel alone. After hearing Mai, Linh felt very sad. She thought about her English lessons and had an idea. "I can use my English studies to spend time with Mai!" she realized. Linh decided to integrate learning with family time. She would try simple English games and educational apps. They could practice words and phrases together during breaks and meals. Because of this, Linh started using English games and apps with Mai. They practiced new words and phrases together every day. Linh's English skills improved quickly, helping her feel more confident during work calls. More importantly, Mai laughed and learned, enjoying their shared time. Their communication gap closed, and their bond grew stronger. Linh found joy in their learning journey. Because of this, Linh's work calls became easier, and her confidence grew. She and Mai continued their daily English games, filling their apartment with laughter. Their shared language journey transformed their home. Linh realized that learning together wasn't just about English; it was about understanding, connection, and building a stronger, happier family, one word at a time. Linh successfully balanced work and family, bridging the communication gap with Mai through shared English learning. Their bond grew stronger, proving that language can connect hearts.
